sn56.49:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso sinerussa pabbatarājassa satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhipeyya.
sn56.49:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yā vā satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā, sineru vā pabbatarājāti?
sn56.49:1.6: saṅkhampi na upenti upanidhimpi na upenti. kalabhāgampi na upenti. sineruṃ pabbatarājaṃ upanidhāya satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittāti.
sn56.49:1.7: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa abhisametāvino etadeva bahutaraṃ dukkhaṃ yadidaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ, appamattakaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ,
sn56.49:1.8: saṅkhampi na upeti upanidhimpi na upeti kalabhāgampi na upeti purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuparamatā.
sn56.49:1.9: yo “idaṃ dukkha”nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn56.49:2.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
